effects.description: The recipient has a percentage chance to miss their Combo Attacks, and not deal any damage. Combo Attacks that are missed do not generate any Mana for the attacker. Miss chance stacks along with any Miss chance from other sources, such as from skills.

bio: The Nautila that went diving for treasure is not the same Nautila that surfaced on one stormy Freeport night, when her crew had lost all hope of her return. While she speaks with the same voice and seemingly has the same body, her words drip with a unsettling hunger. The eyes that stare out of the helmet glisten with an unfathomable malice. What could be in there?
